aboutPage.title: About Us
aboutPage.lead: Saad Jamal Al-Asmari Contracting Establishment, based in Dammam, supplies scaffolders, welders and general and specialized manpower.
story: At Saad Jamal Contracting we focus on specialist manpower, scaffolders above all, together with welders and general and specialist workers.
We meet your project needs with flexible supply, temporary or for the length of the project, under a written scope that fixes numbers, trades, duration and site requirements before work starts.
We are a new company, and we treat that as an advantage: we work with clear management methods, document everything, and aim to make your first project with us the start of a long relationship.

faq.title: Quick answers before you get in touch

items.q: What services does Saad Jamal Contracting provide?
items.a: We provide scaffolders supply, welder supply, and general and specialized manpower for construction, maintenance and industrial projects across Saudi Arabia.

items.q: Which scaffolding types can your workers handle?
items.a: System scaffolding (Cuplock, Ringlock, Kwikstage), tube and fitting, mobile and tower, and suspended and cantilever scaffolds, including erection, inspection and dismantling.

items.q: How do I get a quotation?
items.a: Contact us through the form or email info@saadjamal.sa, and tell us the trades, numbers, duration and project location. We review the request and send a written quotation.

items.q: How long can you supply workers for?
items.a: Temporary or for the length of the project. State the expected duration and start date in your request and they are fixed in the quotation.

items.q: Do you serve only specific cities?
items.a: We serve projects across Saudi Arabia, and our office is in Dammam.

sections.p: This website (saadjamal.sa) is operated by Saad Jamal Al-Asmari Contracting Establishment.

When you submit the contact form, your details are sent to the website server and then to our inbox through the email provider Resend so we can handle your request. We do not store them in a database on the website. The site may use strictly necessary cookies, or analytics if we enable them in future.
We use the information you send us only to answer your enquiry and prepare a quotation. We do not sell your data or share it with third parties for marketing.
You may ask to see, correct or delete your data at any time by contacting us.
For any question about this policy, please reach us through the Contact page.
